text:
Leah Kim: seeing a small but consistent rise in 503s for embed-service in prod-us-east since 20:40 UTC. proposing a hotfix (v2.2.3-hotfix) during the 20:50-21:00 squeeze. can we fast-track?
Omar Haddad: what's the change? risk?
Leah Kim: tiny patch: bounds check on pooling logic. CI green, unit+integration pass. very low blast radius.
Priya Nair: ops  can we accept a fast-track canary-skip for this 10m window if QA signs off in parallel?
OpsBot: opsbot: canary-skip allowed for this window with QA signoff. rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >0.8% OR 95p latency +200ms for 3m.
QA-Checker: running smoke + perf now. ETA ~5m. will post results.
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.2.3-hotfix -> prod-us-east (4 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-7060707070. link: https://internal/redwood/deploys/7060707070
QA-Checker: smoke done. perf quick-check: 95p latency improved ~60ms, no regressions. :white_check_mark:
Omar Haddad: pinning to us-hotfix pool on deploy start: `trafficctl pin --pool us-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.2.3-hotfix --note "hotfix-7060707070"`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied. LB propagation confirmed to 2 edges.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/4 ready). healthcheck path=/ready expected 200.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout progress 4/4 ready. rollout complete. run_id=deploy-7060707070. live traffic routed.
Leah Kim: monitoring 10m watch now. if any of rollback criteria hit, execute rollback and unpin.
QA-Checker: 10m watch complete, metrics stable, error trace rate down. LGTM.
Omar Haddad: leaving pin for 30m for safety then auto-unpin: `trafficctl unpin --after 30m --pool us-hotfix --service embed-service`
Leah Kim: drafting release note: "embed-service v2.2.3-hotfix  fixes pooling bounds causing intermittent 503s. Deployed to prod-us-east during 20:50-21:00 UTC; pinned to us-hotfix pool for 30m. QA passed. Rollback criteria documented."
Priya Nair: thanks team, closing thread and filing follow-up to add more synthetic checks around pooling.
